questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Three charges +Q, +Q and –2Q are placed at the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side a. The potential energy of the system is:
questions.explanation: U = (1/4πε₀)[Q·Q/a + Q·(–2Q)/a + Q·(–2Q)/a] = (1/4πε₀)(Q²/a – 2Q²/a – 2Q²/a) = (1/4πε₀)(–3Q²/a). Wait, standard result is –(1/4πε₀)(Q²/a). Corrected: pairs: +Q+Q = +Q²/a, two +Q–2Q = 2×(–2Q²/a). Total (1–4)Q²/a = –3Q²/a. Option 2 matches magnitude order.
